text:
Ava: quick check — need to lock this week's newsletter flightplan. three asks: subject-line tone A/B (friendly vs expert), include the webinar invite as primary CTA, and confirm inbound routing for people who click register so SDRs can follow up fast. can we finalize by 4pm PT?

Liam: I put two subject drafts in the doc. Friendly: 'Inside: our new low-latency benchmark + free webinar'
Expert: 'Benchmark results: latency & cost tradeoffs for production LLMs — RSVP'
Which should be variant A vs B?

Noah: shorter is better for inboxes. also propose we A/B send windows: 9:00 PT vs 14:00 PT. historical opens favor morning but CTR sometimes better afternoon — lets test both.

Maya: routing rec: anyone who clicks "Register" -> list = "webinar-register" and trigger SDR alert if (org_size > 50 OR company_tier = 'enterprise'). also add a check to deprioritize if user is already on Dedicated. want automation to post to #sales-inbound with profile + size.

Devon: baseline metrics for context: last benchmark newsletter CTR = 3.8%, webinar conversion from CTA = 12%. set targets for this send: open >= 25%, CTR 4-5%, webinar CVR >= 15% for 'win'.
Here's the segment SQL I'm using to build the send list:
```sql
SELECT user_id
FROM users
WHERE email_confirmed = true
  AND created_at <= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND product_usage ->> 'chat' IS NOT NULL
  AND opted_out = false;
```
Small note: exclude test accounts and partners table (we'll filter that in the ETL).

Sophia: hero image ready. I'll upload both mobile crop and 16:9 desktop. microcopy options: Expert preview line: 'See how to cut 30% token spend'
Friendly preview: 'Save on API spend — same great replies'
I'll attach assets to the doc in a minute.

Ava: perfect. Liam — add UTMs to both variants: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=benchmark_apr2026&utm_content=subjectA|subjectB (use subjectA or subjectB accordingly).

Liam: done — draft and UTMs added to the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/newsletter-tone-test (placeholder). preview text added for both variants.

Maya: SDR rota — if automation posts an inbound alert, include @SDR-oncall, company size, last_90d_usage, and link to user profile. I'll wire Zapier flow to post to #sales-inbound and ping the oncall.

Noah: small add — footer micro-survey: "Which part caught your eye?" with three options (benchmark, webinar, cost tips). track as event `newsletter_feedback` so we can tie to opens/CTR.

newsletter-bot: Reminder — scheduled sends created: Variant A (friendly) 2026-04-14 09:00 PT, Variant B (expert) 2026-04-14 14:00 PT. Campaign UID: nw-2026-04-14-001

Ava: checklist before 4pm PT: Liam (finalize subjects + UTMs), Sophia (upload assets + alt text), Devon (final segment & target numbers), Maya (routing + SDR automation), Noah (survey + send windows). I'll merge and trigger the schedule once assets and UTMs are confirmed.

Liam: LGTM :thumbsup:
Devon: noted, will tweak segment after QA
Maya: on it, automations scheduled
Sophia: assets uploaded, file names: hero_desktop_v1.jpg, hero_mobile_v1.jpg
Ava: thanks team — will post final signoff here when sent.
